value.rationale: The transitive tournament is the canonical acyclic tournament, and its directed edge polytope is the complete positive type-A root hull in the standard incidence realization. The theorem gives a full Euclidean radial spectrum in every dimension and identifies a sparse support phenomenon: only the simple roots control the minimum sphere among all positive roots. The exact positive barycentric certificate explains why the Hamilton path, rather than the transitive shortcut edges, determines the global Euclidean one-center. This is a natural family-wide metric invariant not supplied by the source's face or triangulation theory.
